<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Inflation and Rate Hike Outlook:</strong> August retail inflation rose to 4.82%, prompting analysts to anticipate potential RBI repo rate hikes of 25 bps in both October and December to combat inflationary pressures.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiugFBVV95cUxOZDNVX001YjdkcHZCU3BVWjFycDlxX25oWlMxbXE5clF2NWZPLWRycFhoMV9zaDY2eHdwZzg2QjFfZXV6Z09RZmVVQW91QklGZUFRQTd4WXdWTy1hRzJ0Rnh0bkN0cVpvakoxU19NX3llTUtlWW93M0l0SFhCeWI0RDZ0cEFnakpYTEM1YlJ2VUphN2w1ci1HOV82ekdKd2x4U2VmNkxGcExPNUdJX1c4dnBfUERPYk5ka0E?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market Correction:</strong> The Sensex fell 778 points and the Nifty dropped to a five-month low below 23,200, as broad-based selling pressure offset gains in the IT sector.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I21</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizgFBVV95cUxPQ2kxWG9FYWJSRWpoakp2Ty10NzhNcllDZ0M3OUYwQmxYSVhuV2J5OWZRRzlXVFlMSXVZSThRbjNndW42aDJjbjEta3R1S2U2T2drQWdKb3REaHlvS2I2LW5sX0VNR1pvb3I2ZmJ4NC1uOUVNaklyVzJmN0tSTlFIMzlXbjhtYnhoT1BVQ1VXVE9ibDdQdVZZcW45RUJtLVZzaXhWOXZHM25hQTdqMHh1WnY5M0lqM3NQRHJJeTRVOG1ObE5vRllhT09nWnJfZw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I27</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>NSE IPO:</strong> The NSE IPO is set to open on September 17 with a price band of ₹1,700–₹1,785, drawing significant investor interest as the exchange prepares for its market debut.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikAFBVV95cUxOdjJ0TkRrVjJCNGMwZm9BdWtYZGZmTnJKYWQzdnBmQzNfdkZWT0htNk90V001X3N1M0V0SlJRVERpbU16UFBVOUJURlpwbDZhaGNLXzhzUmFTcFVJeVF0RFBvUmFDdWZkOEUtWU9QT1hyQ3dsRkFDS1dPR0JmdzZzSExsNU1uaEg3VDhpSmlqNFE?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxOa1RFb3dMbG5kN1AtS3hmNUs5clQxM2RjcTZ0aHRPbWpSSE9HLTRjX3Izd0dlaUQ1NHcxYjk2ZlQ1cUxkblVXVHQ1NEtPeXVpMjI5N0xKaS1nRUdHVkNsR1RrY2psWEFZU3BlVkMtLXZfakJHVDJZdGVOU21ycnA4YU1WUzhmNW5ZYWdzbng2Z2hKNlJqaHdFTnhaVXdNVEpIUlU2VUp3?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I15</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I16</a></span></li>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Crude Oil and Bond Yields:</strong> Indian assets faced pressure as global crude oil prices surged past $108 per barrel and US bond yields reached 19-year highs, weighing heavily on domestic equity and currency markets.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxPa1dTUVl5SlpUMUxfcU1tM1hFM20tNjVJOUpQUU1GMW5QcXU5SWpJOUQzY0dnVExMVk42Q0JpYmRvaTBCOWdOZUtrOVlHMjBzWnVxNlZ6NUN0dGp0c1FwVTVJdUlxT2xWc0Z4dFpDaF9EMTdpVzBEanZEQy1SVHpTV3dWbzN3QkV0RHU2eFpWbnB4dkV4S3FFSVhESUIybWQ3VVVVUE1VMi15NW9ySGc?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W13</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W14</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W16</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Rupee Depreciation:</strong> The combination of elevated oil prices and rising global yields dragged the Indian rupee toward the 96-per-dollar mark, complicating the domestic macroeconomic outlook.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxONFNJS3dyOHd2elVwMkRlLVp6VkY3WXZlOHBMcWMtSmhCRjZQWXY5TEZ5SHd4cmVsU0o4Q3VoNjBHaEZCWVpPZ0g2R191WE5nNUZYd0RwOFpBXy16S1MzbS0xU1J6OE5Qbm1DdndtNmE1RTZWUzVCRWxrXzIzWGRDVXRIWGRaOHF2U2xjQ3dGeUdfVTlfMDdTV1Y2SVI2c3RZN1ZmUUp6VlBJWjVMTUE?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W12</a></span></li>
